description: Look up the GST/VAT standard rate that applied in a country ON A GIVEN DATE, rather than today's rate. Use it when reconciling or amending a past transaction, invoice or return — several countries changed rate recently (Estonia twice since 2024, Finland, Kazakhstan, Russia, Romania, Slovakia, Ghana, Israel, Ecuador), so the rate today is not the rate that applied then. For the current rate use tax_rate_lookup. The answer states plainly whether a real dated change backs it or whether only the present rate is on record.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. FI, EE, KZ

date.description: The date to resolve the rate for, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '2024-06-30'

name: tax_rate_as_of

dataVerifiedOn.description: ISO date the rate data was last confirmed against the authority

datedChange.description: True when a real recorded rate change backs this answer. FALSE means only the present rate is on record for this country, so an earlier change would not be visible here.

disclaimer.description: General-information note that must accompany any figure shown to a person

effectiveFrom.description: ISO date the dated record that answered took effect. A new record can open without the standard rate moving (a reduced-rate change, or a new instrument restating the same rate), so for when THIS rate took effect read rateSince

effectiveTo.description: ISO date that record closed, or null if it is still open

isCurrent.description: True when this is also the rate in force today

mayBeStale.description: True once the verification date is over a year old — re-confirm with the authority

rateSince.description: ISO date this standard rate took effect — the start of the unbroken run at this rate, which can be earlier than effectiveFrom

rateUntil.description: ISO date this standard rate stops applying, or null when no change is on record

source.description: The national tax authority the figures were verified against (e.g. 'ATO — ato.gov.au')

sourceUrl.description: https link to the authority page the rate was verified against. Present only on rate answers backed by a verified ledger row — absent (never empty) otherwise, so its presence is itself the claim

standardRate.description: Standard rate in force on that date, as a fraction (0.24 = 24%)

standardRateDisplay.description: The same rate formatted for reading

title: Historical tax rate lookup
